title: Spring Boot Fundamentals
description: Test auto-configuration, dependency injection, configuration, and REST controller basics.

questions.questionText: Which annotation commonly marks the main Spring Boot application class?
questions.solution: @SpringBootApplication combines configuration, component scanning, and auto-configuration.

questions.questionText: Which annotation exposes a class whose methods return HTTP response bodies by default?
questions.solution: @RestController combines @Controller behavior with automatic response-body serialization.

questions.questionText: Where are Spring Boot application properties commonly stored?
questions.solution: Spring Boot automatically reads application.properties and application.yml from standard locations.

questions.questionText: Which injection style is generally preferred for required dependencies?
questions.solution: Constructor injection makes required dependencies explicit and supports immutable fields and testing.

questions.questionText: What does Spring Boot auto-configuration use to choose configurations?
questions.solution: Auto-configuration activates conditionally based on dependencies, beans, properties, and other context.
